title: Intuit and Perplexity Partner to Bring Trusted Financial Action for Businesses in Perplexity Computer
summary: Partnership brings QuickBooks and Mailchimp to Perplexity Computer. Turn AI answers and insights into decisive financial action.

- Intuit and Perplexity Partner to Bring Trusted Financial Action for Businesses in Perplexity Computer


Today, Intuit and Perplexity announced a strategic partnership to bring the trusted, actionable financial intelligence powering QuickBooks and Mailchimp directly into Perplexity Computer. Together, the companies are empowering millions of Perplexity users to turn AI answers into action with the same financial confidence they expect from QuickBooks and Mailchimp.


This partnership with Perplexity builds on Intuit’s AI-driven expert platform innovation and strategy to meet customers where they are. By extending its platform through new MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors, Intuit is deepening its relationship with millions of existing customers, and reaching new audiences at the exact point of need by bringing trusted financial intelligence to businesses.


“Perplexity has built a popular platform that millions of people use every day, from research to operating across tools and workflows,” said Alex Balazs, Chief Technology Officer at Intuit.” By bringing QuickBooks and Mailchimp experiences into Perplexity Computer, we’re bridging the gap between finding answers to getting personalized insights and taking decisive action. By pairing their AI platform with the rich data and deep domain expertise behind our trusted financial system of intelligence, we’re empowering customers to seamlessly execute complex tasks to successfully run and grow their businesses.”


“Intuit has spent decades making financial products people can actually run a business on, which is why millions of business owners trust them to run their businesses,” said Dmitry Shevelenko, Chief Business Officer at Perplexity. “Those businesses can now put that expertise and intelligence to work for them in Perplexity Computer, going from research and answers to securely executing financial actions in one seamless workflow.”


The partnership uses MCP connectors to enable secure access to QuickBooks and Mailchimp within Perplexity Computer workflows for seamless execution of business tasks. This unified, frictionless experience saves businesses valuable time, so they can focus on what matters most: growing their business. Through the power of the Intuit business platform and Perplexity Computer, new capabilities include managing cash flow by following up on overdue invoices, setting up recurring invoices, and sending payment links; managing workforce needs by retrieving payslips and accessing payroll employee information; and improving marketing campaigns by tracking performance and identifying high-impact actions that drive revenue.


When a user authenticates with their existing QuickBooks or Mailchimp account, their data is accessed through Intuit’s trusted platform, using Intuit’s established security, privacy, and compliance controls. This enables secure execution of complex, high-stakes financial insights and actions within their Perplexity Computer interface.


Starting today, the new[QuickBooks](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=quickbooks) and[Mailchimp](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=mailchimp) experiences are available to users in the U.S. directly within Perplexity Computer:[Connect QuickBooks in Perplexity Computer](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=quickbooks) or[Connect Mailchimp in Perplexity Computer](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=mailchimp) .


All Intuit products, including its embedded AI-powered platform experiences, are built with Intuit’s strong commitment to data privacy, security, and responsible AI governance. Intuit implements technical and organizational safeguards to help protect customer data and privacy using industry-leading technology and practices.
